name: D12 generic interaction-response coverage expansion
status: frozen before event audit and counterfactual simulation
purpose: broaden reusable physical-regime coverage after D11 reached the predeclared architecture-stopping condition
scope: unused transitions from the existing 43-episode, ten-configuration TRAIN trace corpus only; prior inspected TRAIN groups, DEV, and TEST are excluded from selection

definitions.contact_create: any of 12 anonymous contact channels changes 0 to 1
definitions.contact_loss: any contact channel changes 1 to 0, provided no contact is created simultaneously
definitions.velocity_impulse: RMS velocity change is at or above its global unused-transition 80th percentile
definitions.pose_motion: RMS pose change is at or above its 80th percentile after earlier strata are removed
definitions.persistent_motion: three-step RMS velocity is at or above its 80th percentile after earlier strata are removed
definitions.quiet: no contact transition and all three continuous metrics are at or below their 40th percentiles

selection.correlation_control: at most one selected step per source-state-probe path; initially at most two groups per episode-reset configuration in each stratum

simulation.resource_reason: one MuJoCo process prevents desktop resource exhaustion
simulation.selection_within_direction: largest adjacent generic trajectory response on a nine-point scalar action sweep

gates.audit_before_simulation: all six strata must contain at least 96 unused path-distinct candidates
gates.completed_data: exactly 576 groups, 96 per stratum, with finite arrays and expected nested shapes
gates.next: freeze new episode/configuration-blocked fit and validation partitions before any D9b/D10/D11 retraining

restrictions.existing_d9_to_d11_folds: must not select architecture or collection settings
